abstract: We develop a framework to compare the relative effectiveness of subsidizing alternative emission-reducing technologies. We show that an intermediate technology may reduce emissions more effectively than the cleanest technology if it induces sufficiently greater substitution away from the prevailing high-emission technology. We apply the framework to the South Korean passenger vehicle market using a demand model that incorporates mileage heterogeneity, an important determinant of fuel-type choice. First, reallocating existing subsidies from battery electric vehicles (BEVs), the cleanest technology, to hybrid electric vehicles (HEVs), an intermediate technology, would reduce total greenhouse gas emissions by an additional 47\%. Second, for a BEV-focused subsidy policy to outperform an HEV-focused policy, the carbon intensity of electricity generation would need to fall by approximately 45\%. Our findings suggest that HEV subsidies remain more effective than BEV subsidies until consumers become sufficiently willing to switch to BEVs or electricity generation becomes sufficiently decarbonized.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个分析框架，用于比较补贴不同减排技术的相对有效性。研究表明，若中间技术能显著促使消费者从当前高排放技术转向该技术，其减排效果可能优于最清洁技术。我们将该框架应用于韩国乘用车市场，采用了一个考虑里程异质性（影响燃料类型选择的关键因素）的需求模型。研究发现：第一，将现有补贴从最清洁的纯电动汽车（BEV）重新分配至中间技术的混合动力汽车（HEV），可使温室气体总排放量额外降低47%；第二，若要使以BEV为核心的补贴政策效果优于以HEV为核心的政策，电力生产的碳强度需下降约45%。结论表明，在消费者对BEV的转换意愿足够强烈或电力生产实现充分脱碳之前，HEV补贴始终比BEV补贴更有效。
authors: Frank Verboven; Youngjin Hong; In Kyung Kim
china_relevance_reason: 研究对象、数据、政策背景均为韩国，不涉及中国
title: Which Green Technology to Subsidize? Evidence from Electric Vehicles in South Korea
title_zh: DP21757 补贴哪种绿色技术？来自韩国电动汽车的证据

abstract: This article revives and enhances the factor-supply approach to estimate the effects of changes in immigrant supply on wages and employment of US natives. We introduce and validate a skill-based shift-share IV for immigrants’ labor supply. We find a positive impact of immigration on natives' employment and significant imperfect substitutability between natives and immigrants. Consistent with these estimates, we find significant task complementarity and occupational upgrading of native workers in response to immigrants. Finally, we calculate that immigration over 2000-2023 increased wages of non-college-educated natives by 2.6 to 3.4%, with small effects on other groups.
abstract_zh: 本文重新激活并完善了要素供给方法，用以估算移民供给变化对美国本土劳动者工资与就业的影响。我们提出并验证了一种基于技能的偏移份额工具变量，用于衡量移民劳动力供给。研究发现，移民对本土劳动者的就业具有正向影响，且本土劳动者与移民之间存在显著的不完全替代性。与这些估计结果一致，我们还发现本土劳动者在应对移民时表现出显著的任务互补性与职业升级。最后，我们测算得出，2000年至2023年间的移民使未受过大学教育的本土劳动者工资提高了2.6%至3.4%，而对其他群体的影响较小。
title: Immigration's Effect on US Wages and Employment Redux
title_zh: DP21756 移民对美国工资与就业的再审视

abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>This study examines whether household tap water access affects income‐generating work time among employed rural adults in China. While existing studies have mainly examined the effects of improved water access on employment participation, off‐farm transition and household income, this paper focuses on the intensive margin of labour supply within existing livelihood activities. Drawing on household production and time allocation theory, household tap water access is conceptualised as reducing the time cost of routine domestic production, thereby releasing time that may be reallocated to income‐generating work and other household activities. Using rural panel data from the China Family Panel Studies from 2014 to 2022, the analysis applies individual fixed‐effects models and instrumental variables fixed‐effects (IV‐FE) estimates. The fixed effects results show that household tap water access is associated with approximately one additional hour of income‐generating work per week among employed rural adults. Under the IV identifying assumptions, the IV‐FE estimates suggest a larger positive effect. Additional time‐use analysis indicates that household tap water access reduces daily housework time by about 0.29 h and modestly increases midday nap duration, while no statistically significant changes are found for television watching or leisure reading. Heterogeneity analysis suggests that the increase in work time is concentrated among agricultural workers, self‐employed individuals, prime‐age adults and individuals living in households without young children.</jats:p>
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了家庭自来水供应是否影响中国农村就业成年人的创收工作时间。现有研究主要关注改善水资源获取对就业参与、非农转移和家庭收入的影响，而本文聚焦于现有生计活动中劳动力供给的集约边际。基于家庭生产与时间分配理论，家庭自来水供应被概念化为降低日常家务生产的时间成本，从而释放出可能重新分配至创收工作及其他家庭活动的时间。利用2014年至2022年中国家庭追踪调查的农村面板数据，本文采用个体固定效应模型和工具变量固定效应估计。固定效应结果显示，家庭自来水供应与农村就业成年人每周约增加一小时的创收工作时间相关。在工具变量识别假设下，工具变量固定效应估计表明存在更大的正向效应。额外的时间使用分析显示，家庭自来水供应使每日家务时间减少约0.29小时，并适度增加午睡时长，而看电视或休闲阅读的时间未发现统计显著变化。异质性分析表明，工作时间的增加主要集中在农业劳动者、自雇者、壮年成年人以及无幼儿家庭中的个体。

title: From Tap Water Access to Income‐Generating Work Time: Evidence From Rural China

abstract: Amid the growing urgency of climate change and the global pursuit of net-zero emissions, green fiscal policy (GFP) has become an important instrument for sustainable development. This study examines the effect of GFP on urban carbon emission mitigation (UCEM), with particular attention to its mechanisms and heterogeneous impacts. Using panel data for 274 Chinese prefecture-level cities from 2002 to 2022, it employs the Comprehensive Demonstration of Fiscal Policy for Energy Conservation and Emission Reduction as a quasi-natural experiment and applies a difference-in-differences approach. The results show that GFP significantly promotes UCEM, with stronger effects in cities characterized by higher pollution levels. Mechanism analysis indicates that green innovation and lower total energy consumption serve as positive channels, whereas government environmental attention plays a negative mediating role. In addition, entrepreneurial activity strengthens the effect of GFP, while fiscal pressure weakens it. These findings support phased GFP expansion, stricter enforcement in high-pollution cities, stronger incentives in low-pollution areas, improved transparency and supervision, innovation-led efficiency and clean-energy substitution, plus flexible financing to sustain decarbonization. KEYWORDS: Green fiscal policy carbon emission mitigation urban decarbonization sustainable development JEL CLASSIFICATION: Q54 Q58 R11

abstract: We use the US Distributional Financial Accounts to assess how wealth across the income distribution responds to uncertainty shocks. Following an uncertainty shock, we find that wealth inequality between those in the top percentile of the income distribution and those in the bottom fortieth percentile of the income distribution declines. We show that the result is driven by systematic differences in portfolio composition between high income and low income individuals, with high income individuals having greater exposure to high risk assets. The response of high risk asset inequality is negative while the response of low risk asset inequality is positive. Therefore, the decline in wealth inequality is due to high income individuals losing more relative to lower income individuals rather than lower income individuals catching up to higher income individuals.
abstract_zh: 我们利用美国分配金融账户数据，评估收入分布各阶层的财富如何响应不确定性冲击。研究发现，在不确定性冲击发生后，收入分布前百分位群体与后四十百分位群体之间的财富不平等程度有所下降。这一结果源于高收入与低收入群体在资产组合构成上的系统性差异——高收入群体对高风险资产的敞口更大。高风险资产不平等呈负向响应，而低风险资产不平等呈正向响应。因此，财富不平等的下降并非低收入群体追赶高收入群体所致，而是高收入群体相对损失更大。
title: How Wealth Across the Income Distribution Responds to Uncertainty: Insights from the Distributional Financial Accounts
title_zh: DP21755 收入分配各阶层的财富如何应对不确定性：来自分配金融账户的启示

abstract: The regulatory cycles view, according to which periods of deregulation encourage greater risk-taking and credit booms, which culminate in financial crises and are followed by renewed regulation, rests largely on case studies of individual countries or particular crises. This column uses a new dataset covering 14 countries over the past century to show that the pattern observed after the Great Depression has been much weaker since the Global Financial Crisis. The authors argue that the reason is not simply a change in political priorities or regulatory philosophy. Increasing financial integration has made effective banking regulation at the national level progressively more difficult, shifting regulatory authority from national governments towards international coordination.
abstract_zh: 监管周期理论认为，放松管制时期会鼓励更大的风险承担和信贷繁荣，最终导致金融危机，随后迎来新一轮监管强化。这一观点主要基于对单个国家或特定危机的案例研究。本文利用覆盖14个国家过去一个世纪的新数据集，表明大萧条后观察到的这一模式自全球金融危机以来已显著弱化。作者认为，其原因并非仅仅是政治优先事项或监管理念的转变。日益加深的金融一体化使得国家层面的有效银行监管愈发困难，监管权力正从各国政府向国际协调机制转移。
authors: Thilo Nils Hendrik Albers, Alexander Nützenadel, Tobias Scheib
title: Financial globalisation and the weakening of the regulatory cycle
title_zh: 金融全球化与监管周期的弱化

abstract: Globalisation has changed economic research profoundly, making it more comparable, more competitive, and thoroughly quantitative. This column argues that AI may unsettle this new order as thoroughly as globalisation unsettled the old one and discusses the technical and geopolitical mechanisms at work. One prediction can be made with high confidence: someone who wakes up thirty years from now is likely to recognise economics as little as someone who fell asleep thirty years ago and just woke up today.
abstract_zh: 全球化深刻改变了经济学研究，使其更具可比性、竞争性，并彻底走向定量化。本专栏认为，人工智能可能像当年全球化颠覆旧秩序一样，彻底动摇这一新格局，并探讨了其中涉及的技术与地缘政治机制。一个高度可信的预测是：三十年后醒来的人，很可能像三十年前入睡、今天才醒来的人一样，几乎认不出经济学这门学科。
title: AI, the future of economic research and of the many-handed economist
title_zh: 人工智能：经济研究与多面手经济学家的未来

abstract: Equal pay for equal work has been a core EU principle since 1957, yet women across Europe continue to earn less than men, even in very similar jobs. As EU countries begin implementing the new Pay Transparency Directive, greater wage transparency is expected to narrow these gaps. This column explores the potential effects on the 27 EU countries. Equal pay could substantially narrow gender disparities, but the gains are greater where unequal pay among comparable workers is a key driver of the gender pay gap.
abstract_zh: 同工同酬自1957年起便是欧盟的核心原则，然而即便在高度相似的岗位上，欧洲女性收入仍普遍低于男性。随着欧盟各国开始实施新的《薪酬透明指令》，更高的薪酬透明度有望缩小这些差距。本文探讨了该指令对27个欧盟国家的潜在影响。同工同酬可显著缩小性别差异，但在可比劳动者薪酬不平等是性别薪酬差距主要驱动因素的国家，其收益更为显著。
authors: Silvia De Poli, Sofia Maier, Viginta Ivaškaitė-Tamošiūnė
title: The new EU Pay Transparency Directive may reshape wages and the gender pay gap
title_zh: 新欧盟薪酬透明度指令可能重塑工资与性别薪酬差距
